alt: Under the pines, Guhae gives Buphung the leaf crown
Guhae in white, Buphung in court silk, one lamp
Guhae and the boy, Ibiga only as a mural
The boy looks up at the painted lineage
Only the two of them at the harbour doors
Muryuk in the Gaya helm, listening, face still
The same helm. Tears reach the strap.
They meet again in the hwarang yard
Beads caught on the ring, blades crossed
Overhead. Yushin holds Bidam in the middle of the yard.
